from pathlib import Path
import json
from nisayon.engine.io import file_digest, write_json
results=Path("docs/experiments/results/contract-closeout-001")
base=Path("artifacts/engine-integration-001")
checked={}
for stage in ("before-001","before-002","after-001","after-002"):
 manifest=results/(stage+"-files.json")
 rows=json.loads(manifest.read_text())
 folder=base/("contract-closeout-"+stage)
 for name, expected in rows.items():
  p=folder/name
  assert p.stat().st_size==expected["bytes"], p
  assert file_digest(p)==expected["sha256"], p
 checked[stage]={"files":len(rows),"manifest_sha256":file_digest(manifest),"bytes":sum(v["bytes"] for v in rows.values())}
outputs={}
for a,b in (("native-001.json","contract-closeout-native-001.json"),("foreign-001.json","contract-closeout-foreign-001.json"),("input-integrity-after-workflows.json","contract-closeout-input-integrity-after-workflows.json")):
 assert (results/a).read_bytes()==(base/b).read_bytes()
 outputs[a]=file_digest(results/a)
for before in ("required-fields-001.json","required-fields-001-artifacts.json","audit_required_fields.py"):
 import subprocess
 path="docs/experiments/results/engine-integration-001/"+before
 assert Path(path).read_bytes()==subprocess.check_output(["git","show","cc1a072:"+path])
write_json(base/"contract-closeout-retained-output-audit.json",{"schema":"nisayon.contract-retained-output-audit.v1","conformance":checked,"workflow_outputs":outputs,"original_omission_evidence_unchanged":True})
print(json.dumps(checked,indent=2))
